task.description: WF-03 Step 00->1: claimed queue task 512 (ISS-0512, GH#1000). Diagnose the actual shape of the defect class: an async:true test file must never transitively reach Ecto.Adapters.SQL.Sandbox.mode/2 (which checks in every pooled connection, corrupting concurrently-running async tests). This is the third recurrence in this family (ISS-0480 fixed two instances by construction; ISS-0113 OQ-5 flagged the general risk but only guarded a direct caller). Read ISS-0480.yaml and ISS-0113.yaml in full for prior context. Your job: identify the real call graph (which test support files call Sandbox.mode/2 directly today, e.g. tenant_schema_reaper.ex/tenant_template.ex, and how test files could transitively reach them, e.g. via TenantFixture.provisioned_tenant!/1), and produce a diagnosis that CODE-DESIGNER can use to design a static check for mix letflow.check's task chain. Do NOT implement the fix yourself -- route to CODE-DESIGNER next. CAUTION carried forward from the filing note: a naive unanchored grep for 'async: true' matches moduledoc prose too; anchor on a real `use ... async: true` declaration. The check must not false-flag tenant_schema_reaper.ex/tenant_template.ex themselves (they are legitimate mode/2 callers, not async:true test files).
